scenario: Reject signer config with missing key material
preconditions: One signer setting is omitted

preconditions: Lease transitioned to RELEASED

preconditions: Lease expires before signing call

scenario: Reject resource key outside fencing scope
preconditions: Key is not a child of declared scope

scenario: Reject tampered proof
preconditions: Valid proof has signature byte altered

scenario: Reject missing attestation
preconditions: Provider requires signed fencing

scenario: Reject proof signed for another tenant
preconditions: Proof tenant differs from Provider principal tenant

scenario: Reject proof replayed for different scope
preconditions: Proof scope differs from method argument

scenario: Reject proof replayed for another object key
preconditions: Proof resource key differs from target object

scenario: Reject proof reused for a different operation
preconditions: Proof operation differs from Provider method

scenario: Reject proof reused with another idempotency key
preconditions: Proof idempotency key differs from request

scenario: Reject expired and overlong proof
preconditions: Proof expiration is past or exceeds lease/TTL

scenario: Allow same logical operation replay
preconditions: Operation committed and response is lost
operation: Replay same idempotency key with new valid lease proof
expected_result: Original result returned without second mutation

scenario: Register a new active key in local registry
preconditions: Database owner can access provider DB
expected_result: New metadata row exists and secret is not stored

scenario: Accept active new and retiring old keys
preconditions: Both keys registered and runtime key ring contains both
expected_result: Both accepted before old key deadline
required_evidence: Key IDs status rows and successful writes
notes: Coordinator signs only with configured current key

scenario: Reject retiring key after not_after
preconditions: Retiring key deadline passed
operation: Submit proof signed by old key
notes: Revocation window depends on synchronized clocks

scenario: Reject revoked key immediately
preconditions: Key row status is REVOKED
operation: Submit valid HMAC using old runtime secret
expected_result: Provider rejects despite secret still loaded

scenario: Bound proof validity after lease release
preconditions: Proof signed immediately before release
operation: Submit before and after proof expiry
expected_result: Before expiry may still pass; after expiry rejected
notes: Default maximum revocation delay is 15 seconds

scenario: Carry proofs through payload multipart and receipt-last
preconditions: Strict Adapter and configured signer/provider registry
